proof.text: Use the existing proved stalk trivialization [lem-weil-pbc-invertible-stalk-linear-equiv]: $L_x\cong\mathcal O_{X,x}$. Transport the singleton basis of the local ring along its inverse. At $\eta$ this is a linear equivalence over the field $k(X)$ [def-sc-function-field], hence the generic rank is one.

proof.text: For any $x\in U$, equality of germs is equality on a smaller nonempty neighbourhood [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. Apply [lem-sc-invertible-section-zero-on-nonempty-open] to a section with zero germ to prove the germ map $L(U)\to L_x$ injective. If a germ at $x$ specializes to zero at $\eta$, represent it by a section on a neighbourhood $U$ of $x$. The generic germ of this representative is zero, so that representative is zero by this injectivity, and hence the original germ is zero. Thus every specialization map $\lambda_x$ is injective. All these neighbourhoods contain $\eta$ by [def-sc-generic-point].

proof.text: Represent a scalar and a module germ at $x$ on a common neighbourhood. The germ scalar-multiplication formula [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] at $x$ and $\eta$, and germ_stalkSpecializes, give $\lambda_x(a m)=\rho_x(a)\lambda_x(m)$. If $e$ generates $L_x$, then $e\ne0$ since $L_x$ has a singleton basis over the nonzero local ring. Injectivity gives $\lambda_x(e)\ne0$. The generic rank-one result makes this vector a singleton basis over $k(X)$. The generating assumption and the displayed semilinearity give both inclusions in the asserted image formula.

proof.text: For $s\in L(U)$ and $x\in U$, germ_stalkSpecializes gives $\lambda_x(s_x)=s_\eta$, so the generic germ is in every stalk image. Conversely, for each $x\in U$ choose a germ $m_x$ with $\lambda_x(m_x)=\tau$ and represent it by a section $s_x$ on an open neighbourhood $V_x\subseteq U$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. Its generic germ is $\tau$. The intersections $V_x\cap V_y$ contain $\eta$ [def-sc-generic-point]. The restricted sections have equal generic germs, so agree by the germ injectivity proved above. The sheaf gluing property [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] supplies $s\in L(U)$ with these restrictions. Since $U$ is nonempty, choose an index $x$; restriction does not change the germ at $\eta$, so $s_\eta=\tau$.

lean.statement: theorem invertible_module_generic_stalk (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral X] (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] : let η := genericPoint X let lam := fun x : X ↦ TopCat.Presheaf.stalkSpecializes L.val.presheaf ((genericPoint_spec X).specializes (Set.mem_univ x)) let ρ := fun x : X ↦ algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField (∀ x : X, Nonempty (Module.Basis PUnit.{u + 1} (X.presheaf.stalk x) ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk L.val.presheaf x))) ∧ Module.rank X.functionField ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk L.val.presheaf η) = 1 ∧ (∀ x : X, Function.Injective (lam x) ∧ ∀ e : ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk L.val.presheaf x), Submodule.span (X.presheaf.stalk x) {e} = ⊤ → (∃ b : Module.Basis PUnit.{u + 1} X.functionField ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk L.val.presheaf η), b PUnit.unit.{u + 1} = lam x e) ∧ Set.range (lam x) = {τ : ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk L.val.presheaf η) | ∃ a : X.presheaf.stalk x, τ = ρ x a • lam x e}) ∧ (∀ (U : X.Opens) (hU : Nonempty U), let hη := ((genericPoint_spec X).specializes (Set.mem_univ hU.some.val)).mem_open U.isOpen hU.some.property let lamU := TopCat.Presheaf.germ L.val.presheaf U η hη Function.Injective lamU ∧ Set.range lamU = {τ : ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk L.val.presheaf η) | ∀ x : X, x ∈ U → τ ∈ Set.range (lam x)})
